hello.text: Hey, gorgeous. Got a recovery job. Tyger Claws stole a prototype I wrote. Need the code back before they sell another batch. Meet me in Kabuki?

goodbye.text: Finished checking the keys. Their batch's dead. Your copy's clean.

response_a.text: Thanks, V. Still glad I gave you the quickhack.

response_b.text: Keep it offline. I'd like one night without chasing copies.

close.text: And V? The bows are non-negotiable. ♡

sales.title: HEARTBREAKER / wholesale terms
sales.text:
HEARTBREAKER / wholesale terms

CLIENT: six seconds?
BROKER: Standard cutoff. That's the sample build.
CLIENT: Need them agreeable for longer.
BROKER: We removed the cutoff. Longer loops cost extra.
CLIENT: What happens when they disconnect?
BROKER: That doesn't stop this version.
CLIENT: Send a sample. If it burns out, I want a replacement.
BROKER: Hardware damage isn't covered. Terms attached.

archive.title: VK / conditioning-interrupt research
archive.text:
VK / conditioning-interrupt research

Local test notes

Interrupt incoming conditioning commands.
Do not write a replacement preference.

The user needs time to recognise the interruption.
Six seconds is the current limit.

On disconnect:
Restore altered values.
Do not restart the incoming loop.

Still need to check for a watchdog in the regulator.
Can't have it treating the interruption as a fault.

UNSENT DRAFT

You said you couldn't stay angry.
I don't think you're imagining it.

I've got something that might interrupt the regulator.
Call me if you want to try it.

revocation.title: Deployment / preserve before patch
revocation.text:
Deployment / preserve before patch

Before making changes:
Copy the prototype and signing key to isolated storage.
Verify the copy.

Distribution node:
Upload the corrected build.
Use the recovered key to revoke the stolen batch.

Remove the conditioning payload.
Retain the bounded optics interruption.

Cutoff: six seconds.
No automatic restart.

Keep the interface assets.
The hearts and black bows are intentional.

text.ghostline_velvet_crash_description: Blinds the target for 6 seconds with black bows and pink hearts. Optics clear in an explosion of glitch confetti.
text.gl_vk001_heartbreaker_description: Velvet Kade's one-of-a-kind Heartbreaker build. Velvet Crash interrupts combat cyberware for six seconds, with pink pixel hearts and tiny black bows. Restores nobody's affections. Respects everybody's right to refuse.
text.gl_vk001_heartbreaker_effect: Disrupts the target's optics for 6 seconds with pink pixel hearts and tiny black bows, ending in a burst of glitch confetti. Velvet calls it flirting. Your target may disagree.
